subject: HelioCorp activation playbook — product + eng prioritization request
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: HelioCorp activation playbook — product + eng prioritization request

Team —

Quick summary: HelioCorp (Strategic, expected ARR $1.6M) has pushed procurement to finish by 05/31. They want two non-negotiable items in the agreement:

- Model-affinity routing (Helio model instance affinity for the first 30s of a session to preserve context and SLA).
- An automated telemetry export (hourly payloads of latency + per-route token usage to their SIEM).

Both are blockers for Legal/Procurement to sign. The customer has made it clear they will sign immediately after those controls are in the SOW.

Asking: can Product/Engineering commit to an activation playbook we can deliver by 05/31, scope-limited if needed (e.g., affinity as soft guarantee for the pilot, telemetry as scoped export with retention limits)? I attached our version of the mutual operating plan (Helio_MOP_v1.pdf) with the deadlines called out.

Please advise:
- Feasibility and minimal MLP (what's the smallest scoped delivery that addresses procurement?)
- Rough ETA and any blockers (security, infra, rollback plan)
- If not feasible by 05/31, what's the mitigation language we can offer procurement to keep the signature moving?

I realize this is tight — happy to escalate to get engineering time. Anna Liu from Helio is copied on the Cc chain when we move to legal.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Adding context from CS: procurement has threatened to pull the PO unless these items are explicit in the SOW. Helio is committed to a 6-month paid pilot (they are willing to pay a 20% pilot premium for any reliability/capacity guarantees).

Practical asks from our side: if Engineering can deliver a scoped telemetry export + a best-effort affinity lane for the pilot, Legal will accept an acceptance clause that makes the expanded guarantees conditional on a post-pilot roadmap review.

I uploaded a cleaned Mutual Action Plan (Helio_MAP_v2.xlsx) to the Drive link. I've also noted the acceptance criteria they want in helio_acceptance_criteria.txt (summary attached).

Two asks for Product/Eng: please review the attached MAP and confirm the minimal technical commitments we can promise. If helpful, we can run a 30-minute walkthrough with Anna + Evan next week.

-Monica

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HelioCorp activation playbook — product + eng prioritization request

Thanks for the heads-up and the materials. High-level feasibility notes from Eng: we can deliver a scoped telemetry export and a warm-affinity lane for the pilot, but with constraints. Details below.

Telemetry export (ETA: 2 weeks):
- Deliverable: hourly S3/HTTPS export of per-route latency + token counts, schema agreed with Helio. Retention: 30 days.
- Work: export adaptor + lightweight ACL/credentials. We can ship this as a configurable export (company-level toggle).

Model-affinity / warm lane (ETA: 6–8 weeks, feature-gated):
- True hard affinity (pinning a specific model instance per-session) requires allocation changes + additional scheduler work and risk to overall cluster packing.
- MLP approach: per-customer warm pool with soft-affinity (preferential routing to a reserved set of instances) that degrades gracefully. This can be scoped to the Helio pilot only.
- Risk: additional cost and potential throughput loss for shared clusters. We'll need a runbook and canary before prod.

Mitigation language for procurement:
- We can provide: "Scoped pilot commitment: soft-affinity lane + telemetry export delivered by 06/30; hard-instance pinning subject to post-pilot architecture review."

Open questions:
1) Can Sales accept 06/30 for hard guarantees if we give a firm pilot-scoped commitment by 05/31? (that buys us time for the full implementation)
2) Who will own the acceptance criteria sign-off from Helio for the pilot?

I'll set up a short sync with Marissa to scope the MLP and list the exact engineering tasks. Also linking the HubSpot deal for context: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HL-2027-042

- Markus
Senior Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 12:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HelioCorp activation playbook — product + eng prioritization request

Markus — thanks for the pragmatic breakdown. Two points from Sales:

1) Financial impact: Helio will move the PO immediately if we can promise pilot-scoped soft-affinity and the telemetry export by 05/31. If we slip past that date, the risk of losing the close is high (they already bumped legal several times).
2) Commercial concession: Sales is willing to offer a 6-month paid pilot at 120% of normal usage rates to offset early engineering and warm pool costs — we need Product to sign off on acceptance criteria and rollback triggers.

If Eng can deliver the telemetry export by 05/31 and a scoped soft-affinity guarantee with a firm commitment to deliver hard-instance pinning by 06/30, we have authority to approve and push the PO through procurement this week.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anna Liu <anna@heliocorp.com>, Evan Park <evan.park@evan.park@heliocorp.com>, Procurement (HelioCorp) <procurement@heliocorp.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HelioCorp activation playbook — product + eng prioritization request

Thanks all — good alignment. Confirming next steps so we can get procurement moving: 

- Engineering: telemetry export shipped by 05/31 (scoped S3/HTTPS, 30-day retention).
- Product/Eng: commit to pilot-scoped soft-affinity lane by 05/31, with an engineering delivery timeline for hard-instance pinning by 06/30 and a canary plan.
- Sales: publish acceptance criteria to Helio and offer the 6-month paid pilot concession.
- CS: own pilot sign-off and run acceptance tests with Helio.

Action: Markus + Marissa to produce a one-page activation playbook (technical scope, acceptance criteria, rollback plan) by EOD 05/18; Monica will send that to Helio and request their signature.

I'll attach an updated MAP that reflects these commitments. If any party cannot meet their deadlines above, please escalate now so we can consider a short commercial buffer.

Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
